shots.p: wide shot of the starry sky over a silent desert, dunes and mountains lit by moonlight, a sense of vast majesty
Arab bedouins in a simple tent circle by firelight listening attentively, faces transforming from confusion to clarity
close-up of a young Arab boy carefully learning to write on a wooden tablet in warm sand-colored morning light, focused eager face
wide shot of crowds of many nations in varied modest dress walking along one road toward a rising sun
rain falling on dry desert land turning it into green meadows, wide aerial shot, soft golden light
a donkey plodding along a dusty road loaded with heavy stacks of books it cannot read, wide shot, dry humor, afternoon sun
a group of men in a lamp-lit hall boasting arrogantly, turning pale and silent when challenged, close-up on anxious faces
an old wealthy man clutching his gold coins in a lavish room, looking fearfully at a darkening window, hourglass running out
a man running down a long narrow alley at dusk, a long shadow always waiting at its end, hourglass sand nearly empty
a busy Friday market at noon, merchants covering their goods and closing stalls as the call to prayer sounds, men walking toward a mosque
crowds of men exiting a mosque into bright afternoon sun, spreading into fields and markets to work, peaceful content faces
a crowd of men rushing out of a mosque courtyard toward an arriving camel caravan with drums, a few remaining seated in prayer
